name: Slow Cooker Carnitas
source_note: Research candidate — found online, not Kalea's recipe.

time.note: Slow cooker 8 hours + COOK-01 broil to crisp at the end. Start morning of serve day.

prep_lead.prep_ahead: Start in slow cooker morning of serve day.
prep_lead.note: thaw_hours null = compute from frz-pork-shoulder linked weight.

steps: Season pork chunks with salt and cumin.
Place in slow cooker. Add orange juice, lime juice, and garlic.
Cook on low 8-10 hours until very tender and shreddable. Add extra time if underdone at altitude.
Shred pork in the slow cooker. Spread on a sheet pan.
Broil on COOK-01 upper oven 5-7 minutes until edges crisp.
